subject: Urgent: FastCart regional throughput collapse — emergency routing & exec sync
messages:
From: Katie Liao <katie.liao@fastcart.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dan Brooks <dan.brooks@fastcart.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FastCart US-WEST-2 — sustained 5xx/latency spike, customers impacted

Hi Stephanie,

We're seeing a sustained spike in 5xx (service error) and tail latency for all writes routed to us-west-2 starting ~08:50 PDT. Error rate is ~12% and p99 latency is 2.4s vs normal ~180ms — checkout flows are timing out and we're seeing payment failures. This is affecting ~18% of our production traffic and hitting our checkout conversion hard.

Attached is our Grafana snapshot and SLO dashboard (fastcart_slo_dashboard.png). We opened a PagerDuty incident (PDT-48219). Can Redwood immediately route traffic away from us-west-2 while you investigate? Also we need an ETA on root cause and an ask on credits for the outage window.

Please escalate to your on-call/ops and execs — this is high visibility for us.

Thanks,
Katie Liao
Sr. Product Ops, FastCart
katie.liao@fastcart.com

---
Attachment: fastcart_slo_dashboard.png (image/png)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Katie Liao <katie.liao@fastcart.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastCart US-WEST-2 — sustained 5xx/latency spike, customers impacted

Katie — thanks for the signal and the dashboard. We're on it. Immediate plan (first 30m):
- Opened an internal incident and PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PDT-48219
- Requesting permission to steer traffic off us-west-2 to us-east-1 (canary 30% -> 75% if stable). Please confirm you accept cross-region routing for your customer traffic.
- Will enable smaller model variant and reduced batch size for FastCart routes to reduce per-request tail latency while we debug.
- Ops will flush KV prefix cache for hot keys (to avoid cache-coherence amplification).

Sean/Vanessa/Marissa — can you confirm capacity in us-east-1 and runbook steps (see attached mitigation_runbook_v2.pdf). If we need to reduce concurrency on writes, call it out now.

We will schedule an exec sync at +90m and loop in customer leadership if needed.

-Stephanie
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: mitigation_runbook_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastCart US-WEST-2 — capacity check and routing plan

Ack — checking capacity now. Quick notes:
1) us-east-1 has reserve headroom on Dedicated pools but we need to move the FastCart pin to the higher-throughput nodeclass to sustain writes at current QPS. I can allocate and pin immediately; that will add ~12s for instance provisioning (warm).
2) We should route incrementally: 30% -> 55% -> 80% in 5m windows while monitoring 5xx and p95/p99.
3) Enable model variant ridge-small-v2 for write flows — reduces tokenization latency but may slightly change hallucination characteristics (not relevant for checkout).
4) Ops: flush KV prefix caches and disable prefix prefetch for 10m to avoid read amplification.

Also adding a note: Legal/Finance will ask about SLA credits. If FastCart requests immediate credit approval for the window, I need an exec sign-off. Recommending we hold that conversation until the incident is stable, then propose a goodwill credit (1–3 days $ credit) pending RCA.

-Sean
Head of Customer Success (EMEA/NA)
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastCart US-WEST-2 — mitigation runbook updates

Capacity confirmed: us-east-1 Dedicated pool has room if we bump the nodeclass. I'll start the pin and warm hot-path instances now (target: +15m warm). Networking note: confirm that FastCart allows cross-region failover — potential impact is increased latency for nearby users, we should throttle slowly.

Runbook changes I'm making now (logged in mitigation_runbook_v2.pdf):
- Add automated rollback trigger: if 5xx > 3% for 3 consecutive 2m windows during canary, auto-rollback steer by 50%.
- Set routing policy to prefer lower-cost nodeclass only if p95 < 800ms.
- Add human-in-loop for credit/exec outreach.

Marissa — please prepare a short exec one-pager explaining tradeoffs and the ask for a discretionary customer credit (draft due in 20m).

-Vanessa
Head of Ops
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastCart US-WEST-2 — regional mitigation complete and next steps

Katie/Team — quick update and what we did in the first 4 hours: 
- Traffic steering: Incremental canary performed: 30% -> 60% -> 90% to us-east-1 over 30 minutes. Observed error rate drop from 12% -> 1.1% and p99 latency down from 2.4s -> 210ms.
- Model variant: ridge-small-v2 enabled on routed traffic; write correctness verified in synthetic checks.
- KV cache: flushed hot prefixes; prefetch paused for 12 minutes to avoid amplification.
- Allocation: us-east-1 Dedicated pin warmed and sustained the extra load.

Current status: customer-visible errors are below baseline, checkout flow recovered for the majority of users. We're keeping the routing in place for 6 hours while we continue deeper RCA on a storage backend degradation in us-west-2. We'll share an RCA and a proposed credit package within 48 hours.

Next immediate asks for FastCart: please confirm you accept the temporary cross-region routing for the 6h window (we will keep traffic steering conservative for specific routes). Also confirm if you'd like a joint postmortem with your infra team — we can schedule tomorrow.

Apologies for the impact — we're treating this as P0. I'll send a short exec one-pager and the timeline to your leadership shortly.

-Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
